messages.subject: quick question re: probability > 0
parts:
I saw a recent presentation in which the results of a Bayesian model were presented as probability a covariate''s mean was > 0.

I assume there's an easy way to compute this from a brmsfit object? Thanks!

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: quick question re: probability > 0
parts:
Suppose fit is you model object, then you can use for instance

ps <- posterior_samples(fit, "^b_")
colMeans(ps > 0)
